text: Or, Ioshebbassebet the Tachmonite head of the three. , See 1. chr. 11.11. , Heb. slaine.
Or, the three captaines ouer the thirtie.
Heb. great of acts. , Hebr. lion of God.
Heb. a man of countenance or sight: called 1. Chro. 11. 23. a man of great stature.
Or, honourable among the thirtie. , Or, Councill: Heb. at his command
